<thought>Based on the spectrum, a clear M+1 peak (~+1 Da) at 184.048 with ~10 % intensity indicates the presence of carbon (13C). A distinct M+2 peak (~+2 Da) at 185.042 with ~33 % intensity matches the characteristic 35Cl/37Cl isotopic spacing and relative abundance, confirming chlorine. No other element shows a definitive isotopic pattern. Therefore the identifiable elements are carbon and chlorine.</thought>
<final_answer>['C', 'Cl']</final_answer>
